subject: reasoning
question: Sunny starts from point A and drives 11 km towards the east. He then takes a left turn, drives 8 km, turns left and drives 12 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 10 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 1 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given: **

Sunny starts from point A and drives 11 km towards the east.

He then takes a left turn, drives 8 km, turns left and drives 12 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 10 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 1 km and stops at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daf205d00540d90b5850148ab0c549cc58e4abd2206dee64d782d1bfdecb6c95.png] 

Thus, he drive 2 km to the north in order to reach point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
